newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee market in thin pre-holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee market in thin pre-holiday trade.

text.p: Bremen coffee markets were quiet ahead of the upcoming Christmas and New Year holidays, traders said on Friday. Trades were sporadic and seen staying that way.
Outright arabica prices were broadly unchanged on the week, with Brazils staying at $114 per 50 kg fob while Colombians eased $1 to $137.
Robusta prices were reduced, with Indonesia EK-1 at $54 Dec/Jan cif shipment but buyers were not interested, with the exception of some purchases of African origins.
Roasters were seen well covered for first quarter 1997.
NB The next Bremen coffee report will be issued on Jan 10.
